type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: ci(mcore): isolate structural logic certification scope
fix(mcore): minimize structural evidence theorem to certified seven-problem core
feat(mcore): isolate exact universal collapse law over all terminal cores
ci(mcore): gate cross-problem multistate evidence theorem
feat(mcore): cross problem multistate structure with existing signature evidence
fix(mcore): separate universal multistate number from problem manifestations
ci(mcore): gate universal multistate signature theorem
feat(mcore): formalize invariant multistate problem signature number

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.MultistateSignature.distinct_problems_have_distinct_signatures
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {p q : ProblemId} (hpq : p ≠ q) (st : ClosureStage) : (manifest p st).signature ≠ (manifest q st).signature

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.MultistateSignature.manifestation_signature
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : ProblemId) (st : ClosureStage) : (manifest p st).signature = signatureOf p

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.MultistateSignature.same_structural_number
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p q : ProblemId) (st : ClosureStage) : (manifest p st).number = (manifest q st).number

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.MultistateSignature.universal_multistate_manifestation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ p : ProblemId, (manifest p .c0).number = 0 ∧ (manifest p .open).number = 1 ∧ (manifest p .c2).number = 2 ∧ (∀ st : ClosureStage, (manifest p st).signature = signatureOf p)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.UniversalCollapse.structural_evidence_is_classification_only
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : ProblemId) : (realize p .start).number = 0 ∧ (realize p .obstruction).number = 1 ∧ (realize p .terminal).number = 2 ∧ (realize p .terminal).obstruction = obstructionOf p

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.UniversalCollapse.universal_collapse_closes_all
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (F : NucleusFamily) (hU : UniversalCollapseLaw F) : ∀ p : ProblemId, (F.nucleus p).Endpoint

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.UniversalCollapse.universal_collapse_exact
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (F : NucleusFamily) : UniversalCollapseLaw F ↔ (∀ p : ProblemId, (F.nucleus p).Core)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.UniversalMultistateEvidence.realization_preserves_existing_obstruction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : ProblemId) (s : StructuralState) : (realize p s).signature.obstruction = match (realize p s).obstruction with | .primitiveSolution => .primitive | .signedTransferDefect => .transfer | .nonAlgebraicHodgeClass => .algebraicity | .polynomialSATDecider => .complexity | .rankMismatch => .rank | .nonzeroDNLimit => .residue | .nonpositiveSpectralGap => .spectral

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.UniversalMultistateEvidence.same_number_different_problem
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p q : ProblemId) (s : StructuralState) : (realize p s).number = (realize q s).number

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.UniversalMultistateEvidence.universal_structure_distinct_manifestations
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ p : ProblemId, (realize p .start).number = 0 ∧ (realize p .obstruction).number = 1 ∧ (realize p .terminal).number = 2 ∧ (realize p .terminal).kind = manifestationOf p ∧ (realize p .terminal).signature = signatureOf p ∧ (realize p .terminal).obstruction = obstructionOf p
